description: This Java source file defines the UserCreatedShelf class, which extends the Shelf class. It models a user-created shelf in a book tracking application, including properties like a set of books, an ID, and methods for setting the shelf name and equality checks.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelf
classes.description: A class representing a user-created book shelf, extending the Shelf class, with properties for books and ID, and methods for setting shelf name and equality comparison.

methods.name: setShelfName
methods.description: Sets the shelf name, throwing an exception if the name is blank.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare UserCreatedShelf objects based on ID, books, and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hashCode method to generate a hash based on superclass hash, ID, and books.
